summary: Auth recovery bug fix verified. Backend auth endpoints (signup, login, /auth/me) all working correctly. Frontend auth state (token, user, recovery key) persists in localStorage after page refresh. The key fix: useAuth.js now only clears auth state on HTTP 401/403 (actual auth rejection), not on network errors or 5xx responses. Recovery key mechanism added to survive auth wipes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth recovery bug fix verified. The fix ensures that network errors during deploys don't wipe auth state - only actual 401/403 responses clear localStorage. Recovery key (cthulhu_auth_recovery) persists urn+address+network even if main auth keys get wiped. On mount, if recovery data + encrypted wallet exist but no token, user shell is restored and unlock prompt shown. After successful unlock in recovery mode, auto re-login gets fresh JWT.
